evidence.detail: Bugged cards page exists but only shows a table of bug descriptions with GitHub and Bug Blog links
Template shows card/bug/severity/links but has no community voting, upvoting, or WotC submission tools
No child issues or follow-up tasks found for the checklist silasary mentioned in comments
evidence.ref: gh issue list --search 'bug reporting bugged cards' --state open

triage.notes: silasary promised a checklist in 2018 that never materialized. The core request — community organizing to increase WotC bug fix priority — requires product design decisions about voting, external submission mechanisms, and community coordination.
